title: Siberian Traps large igneous province
note: Trigger of the end-Permian extinction; three-stage chronology (Burgess & Bowring 2015; Burgess et al. 2017 Nat Commun, open access), area/volume ranges (Augland et al. 2019). Region per UN M49 (Russian Federation); geographically northern Asia.

title: End-Permian terrestrial turnover in the Karoo Basin
note: Daptocephalus to Lystrosaurus Assemblage Zone turnover, Free State, South Africa; dated 252.24 ± 0.11 Ma (Gastaldo et al. 2020, PMC7080820) versus synchronous view (Smith & Botha-Brink 2014). Under-recorded region in deep time.

title: End-Guadalupian (Capitanian) mass extinction and Emeishan Traps
note: Stanley 2016 (PMC5081622) estimates 33–35% genus loss; its merger with the end-Permian inflated older extinction figures. Emeishan large igneous province in southwest China. Year is the ICS v2024/12 base of Wuchiapingian (259.51 ± 0.21 Ma); refine.

title: Meishan Permian–Triassic boundary section (GSSP)
note: Two GSSPs (base Induan 2001, base Changhsingian 2005), National Geoheritage Reserve 2005, 2.3 km² reserve; ICS GSSP table, Yin et al. 2001 Episodes, IUGS geoheritage listing.

title: Early Triassic biotic recovery
note: Rebuilding of marine and terrestrial ecosystems after the extinction; carbon-cycle volatility ≥500 kyr (Burgess et al. 2014). Needs dedicated recovery literature.

title: Lystrosaurus
note: Survivor dicynodont genus; Karoo, Antarctica, India, China, Russia occurrences; Gondwana distribution also a classic continental-drift argument. Commons media already verified in parent record.
